summary: Metadata-verified single-file streamed execution path for the NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano 30B-A3B (nemotron_h_moe) GGUF on local SSD. Real per-layer weight decode/execution and a genuine full 52-block single-token forward completed; logits/token are genuine-but-UNVALIDATED (no runnable nemotron_h_moe reference on this host).

model.declared_upstream_revision_note: revision value as stated in the task specification; NOT independently re-fetched/verified against the upstream pinned file metadata in this session

architecture.source: read from the real GGUF header/metadata (read-only inspector); not hardcoded from the 120B
architecture.general.name: Nemotron 3 Nano 30B A3B

moe.structure: direct (non-latent): up_exps[2688,1856,128] -> relu^2 -> down_exps[1856,2688,128], plus shared expert; differs from the 120B latent MoE

quantization_coverage_note: All ggml-standard types (no i-quants). Decoded via the pinned native ggml to_float kernel (FFI llmbridge_dequantize_rows_v1).

tokenizer.parity_status: UNVERIFIED — loaded via NemotronTokenizer::from_gguf and used to encode the prompt; NOT compared against an independent reference token-id stream

real_layer_execution.mamba2_layer: one real recurrent block executed to 2688 finite outputs
real_layer_execution.attention_layer: one real attention block (GQA+RoPE) executed to 2688 finite outputs
real_layer_execution.moe_layer: one real direct-MoE block executed to 2688 finite outputs
real_layer_execution.reference_comparison: none available on host; outputs checked finite only

full_forward_generation.validation: genuine model-backed logits; UNVALIDATED (block composition + assumed RoPE convention not reference-checked). Not a correctness-parity claim.

per_token_source_read_profile_bytes.note: computed from the tensor table (no weight payload read); moe_expert counts only expert_used/expert_count of each packed expert tensor

runtime.enclosing_test_overhead_note: the ~996 s beyond the forward is one-time tokenizer/metadata construction + index/profile load; it was NOT separately instrumented
runtime.resource_instrumentation_note: process peak RSS and swap were NOT captured for this forward; streamed path keeps weights non-resident by construction but no RSS proof was recorded

hardware.gpu: AMD RX 580 8 GB (NOT used; no CUDA/modern ROCm; no Vulkan kernels wired)
hardware.note: model file (22.39 GB) exceeds OS-visible physical RAM (13.81 GiB); streamed out-of-core execution is mandatory and was used

comparison_to_120b_experiment.note: The earlier 120B profile (~7736 MiB/token, ~10 MiB/s, ~705-770 s/token) used a slow external G: drive AND a larger model with top-22 routing. Nano is smaller (2.47 GB/token), top-6, on SSD. The ~25 MB/s effective rate here is CPU/compute-bound (scalar single-token matvec + dequant), NOT an SSD bandwidth measurement; the two experiments differ in BOTH model and storage and must not be attributed to storage alone.

regression.flaky_note: memory_pressure::tests::hysteresis_unknown_and_manual_pause_keep_gates_independent failed ONCE during a native suite run that overlapped a concurrent 22 GB sha256 read (live available-RAM sampling perturbed) and PASSED on isolated re-run and on a clean full re-run. Not related to the nemotron_nano change (isolated new module).

git.code_commit: e86951f (feat(model): Nemotron 3 Nano 30B nemotron_h_moe metadata-driven plan + streamed hybrid forward)

known_limitations: Block composition and the assumed GGML-NeoX partial-RoPE convention are NOT validated against a runnable nemotron_h_moe reference; generated logits/token are genuine-but-UNVALIDATED (spec §20).
Tokenizer ID parity vs an independent reference was not run.
No CLI `nano` subcommand and no local inference server are wired yet (library + gated tests only).
Process peak RSS and swap were not instrumented for the full-forward run.
~25 MB/s effective throughput is CPU/scalar-bound, not an SSD bandwidth measurement; single-token latency ~99 s makes multi-token generation impractically slow without further optimization.
Declared upstream revision was not independently re-verified by fetching upstream file metadata in this session.
